motions.clearance: Head lowers behind the cab roof before the limbs close; fins clear the shoulders through the full slide.

Leg swings rearward beneath the cab after arms fold; boot clears waist at midpoint and seats alongside the other leg.
Leg swings rearward beside its mate after arms fold; boot clears waist at midpoint and aligns into the paired chassis.

checks: Robot source keeps a broad shoulder line, red windowed chest, helmet fins, and twin stacks.

Both arms remain connected at shoulder sockets and fold alongside the cab without crossing the grille.
Both leg groups retain their layered shells and soles while rotating rearward as one connected chassis assembly.
